usedFor: Lago holds customers and invoices, and MailerLite holds your subscribers, so “New Customer Created” can run “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Lago, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: Each new billing customer joins your list, and a returning one is updated rather than duplicated.

watchOut: “New Invoice Created” and “New Payment Arrives” in Lago are polling, so subscriber updates in MailerLite follow a scheduled check.
